title: From Data to Wisdom: Rethinking AI Through an Epistemic Lens
abstract: arXiv:2611.16726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes the Data-to-Wisdom Epistemic Architecture for AI (EAAI), a conceptual framework treating Data, Information, Knowledge, Understanding and Wisdom as five distinct but recursively interacting epistemic functions: observation, contextual interpretation, modeling and prediction, critical evaluation and informed judgment. Two observations motivate it: sequential readings of the Knowledge Pyramid obscure how these functions interact, and a targeted review of ten Bayesian reference books finds that prior distributions are defined mathematically while "prior information" and "prior knowledge" are not consistently distinguished as epistemic categories. A Bayesian interpretation relates the likelihood, prior and posterior distributions, posterior prediction, model checking and decision analysis to the five functions, without limiting EAAI to Bayesian systems. translated_title: 从数据到智慧：以认识论视角重新思考人工智能
translated_abstract: 本文提出了“数据到智慧的人工智能认识论架构”（EAAI），这是一个概念框架，将数据、信息、知识、理解和智慧视为五种既相互独立又递归相互作用的认识功能：观察、情境解释、建模与预测、批判性评估以及知情判断。该框架的提出基于两点观察：一是对知识金字塔的顺序式解读掩盖了这些功能之间实际的相互作用方式；二是对十本贝叶斯参考书的有针对性综述发现，先验分布在数学上有明确定义，但“先验信息”和“先验知识”并未作为认识论范畴得到一致区分。本文通过贝叶斯解释将似然、先验和后验分布、后验预测、模型检验和决策分析与这五种功能联系起来，同时并不将EAAI局限于贝叶斯系统。在认识论意义上扩展“先验”概念，本文区分了五（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出数据到智慧的人工智能认识论架构（EAAI），将数据、信息、知识、理解与智慧视为五种递归相互作用的认识功能，并以贝叶斯推断为例说明如何用该框架统一解释AI系统中的观察、解释、预测、评估与判断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Data-to-Wisdom Epistemic Architecture for AI (EAAI), a conceptual framework treating Data, Information, Knowledge, Understanding and Wisdom as five distinct but recursively interacting epistemic functions, illustrated through a Bayesian interpretation linking likelihood, prior, posterior, model checking and decision analysis.
